title: bino.toml
description: Project configuration of a bino report project.

report-id.description: Unique identifier of this reporting project. 'bino init' sets a UUID.

engine-version.description: Template engine version to use, for example "v1.2.3". Without it the latest locally installed version is used.

template.description: The template this project was scaffolded from. Written by 'bino init'.

plugins.description: Plugin binaries this project loads, by plugin name.

url.description: URL of the registry service. Defaults to the public bino registry.

token.description: Token for private packages: a literal value or a single "${VAR}" environment reference. Falls back to BINO_REGISTRY_TOKEN; empty means anonymous.

dependencies.description: Registry packages: "@scope/name" = exact version ("1.2.3", pinned) or a tag name ("latest", "stable", ...).

package.description: Marks this project as a predef project that authors a reusable registry package.

name.description: Package name, "@scope/name" with lowercase a-z0-9_- segments.

description.description: Short description shown in the registry.

compat-engine.description: Semver range of supported template engine versions.

compat-cli.description: Semver range of supported bino CLI versions.

include.description: Project-relative directories and files to publish.

trust.description: Which registry packages must be signed, and by whom.

require.description: What happens to an unsigned package or one no rule accepts: off accepts it (the default), warn accepts it with a warning, signed fails. An invalid signature always fails.

signer.description: Signer rules. Set exactly one signer kind: oidc-issuer (keyless), x509-root or key-file.

scope.description: "@scope/*" for every package of a scope, or "@scope/name" for one package.

oidc-issuer.description: Keyless: the OIDC issuer of the Sigstore certificate, matched exactly.

identity.description: Keyless or x509: the certificate identity (the SAN), matched exactly.

repository.description: Keyless: the source repository of a CI workload. Set together with workflow, instead of identity.

workflow.description: Keyless: the workflow that signed, without the @ref part. Set together with repository.

x509-root.description: x509: a PEM CA certificate, relative to this file.

key-file.description: Key: a PEM public key (ed25519, ECDSA or RSA), relative to this file.

version.description: Optional semver pin of the plugin.

path.description: Optional explicit path to the plugin binary.

hook_timeout.description: Timeout for plugin hooks, for example "60s".

hooks.description: Shell commands to run at a checkpoint, in order.

args.description: Default command-line flags, by flag name without the leading dashes. Explicit flags win.

env.description: Environment variables for the command, as KEY = "value" here or under values. Variables already set in the environment win.

values.description: Environment variables. On a duplicate name these win over keys written directly under env.

hooks.description: Hooks for this command. They replace shared hooks of the same checkpoint.
